name: rx_lsb_first
why: received bits shift in from the top, so the byte arrives bit-reversed

name: sample_on_falling_edge
why: MISO sampled when SCLK falls (mode 1 timing) instead of when it rises

name: half_period_one_long
why: each SCLK half period lasts HALF_PERIOD+1 clk cycles

name: parameter_ignored
why: hard-codes the default half period of 2 cycles

name: mosi_shift_on_rise
why: MOSI advances at the rising SCLK edge, violating mode 0 data setup

name: seven_bit_transfer
why: the transfer ends after 14 SCLK toggles, one bit short

name: accept_while_response_held
why: cmd_ready ignores a held response, so a new transfer can start and overwrite it

name: response_dropped_under_stall
why: rsp_valid clears after one cycle even while rsp_ready is low

name: reset_keeps_transfer
why: reset idles the bus pins but lets the transfer counter keep running

name: asynchronous_reset
why: an off-edge reset pulse aborts an active transfer
replace: always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin // spi_fsm
